lead.headline: 0-3, and Achane's knee still has no answer
lead.deck: Footballers finished on 140.6. The lineup was right; three starters got hurt.
lead.body: No MRI result for De'Von Achane had been reported by this morning's snapshot, and every report since Sunday points to a long absence: Miami's coach said it 'does not sound optimistic'. Justin Jefferson's ankle sounds minor, per Kevin O'Connell, and Jalen Coker's quad diagnosis is due within two days. Stafford's Sunday night took Footballers to 140.6 against AVIATO's 103.8, a third straight loss. The lineup as set was the projection lineup. Tuten is first in line for Achane's slot, and Tuesday's run decides Ollie Gordon before claims process at 01:00 Wednesday.

doFirst.headline: Nothing to do this morning
doFirst.deck: Two Week 4 plans are set; neither can be done until rosters unlock after tonight.
doFirst.note: If Achane is ruled out, start Tuten in his RB slot. If Jefferson or Coker can't go, McLaurin starts, then Boston. Both are in the brief as 'When rosters unlock' cards.
doFirst.empty: Nothing left to decide this week: every starter is final and rosters stay locked until after Monday night.

roster.deck: The lineup as set was the projection lineup, and every starter is final, so nothing can change until Week 4.

wire.headline: Nothing on the wire beats this roster
